title: Version Update Announcement
summary: Adapted for the Mac desktop app and improved sync, search, and layout experiences. Added backend v0.29 support.

contents: macOS desktop support: you can now use MemoFlow directly on your Mac.
Added Storage, making it easier to view and clear cached data.
Adapted to the Memos 0.29 base API.
Optimized the desktop layout to reduce page crowding and content overflow.
Adjusted desktop navigation, settings pages, and secondary page interactions to better match desktop usage habits.
Optimized page density across devices for a more consistent experience on phones, tablets, and desktops.
Improved server address input for a smoother login experience with self-hosted Memos instances.
For Memo 0.27+, interaction information such as likes and comments now supports real-time refresh.
Fixed inaccurate sync for some Memo update times, making list sorting more stable.
Improved home page search logic, with clearer search states and result scope.
Adjusted tag recognition rules to reduce cases where body content is mistakenly recognized as tags.
